theorem_title: Pruned offline program correctness for arbitrary rational parameters
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSumSharpTail.pruned_program_correct (G : Light.Sec4.RatParams) : ∀ lim,
    Light.Sec4.OfflineSpec32P lim (Light.Sec4.program31P G) Light.Sec4.cShared30 G := by sorry
natural_language_statement: For every finite rational parameter record G, the published program31P(G) satisfies OfflineSpec32P at every machine limit. It executes the specified preprocessing and queries on the actual stored matrices and selected entries, with the declared step counts. This is the generic correctness interface of the pruned program; asymptotic cost regimes, word-size polynomial bounds and the 3SUM reduction are separate conclusions.
